result.instructions: Tools for Rotageek, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is scheduled at our Leeds site next Monday, and who is on leave?"; "Show the open gaps in the rota for the next two weeks."; "Which staff have a leave request waiting for approval this month?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Rotageek data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run rotageek_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rotageek_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rotageek_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. rotageek_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rotageek_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users (staff) in the organisation, optionally filtered by user ids or a location. Use it first to find the user ids the other tools need. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/users.

location_id.description: Only users at this location id.

tools.name: rotageek_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id: name, contact details, primary location and status. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/users/{userId}.

tools.name: rotageek_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the locations (sites) of the organisation. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/locations.

tools.name: rotageek_get_location
tools.title: Get a location
tools.description: Get one location by id, with its settings. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/locations/{locationId}.

tools.name: rotageek_list_location_users
tools.title: List users at a location
tools.description: List the users assigned to one location. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/locations/{locationId}/users.

tools.name: rotageek_list_user_shifts
tools.title: List a user's schedule
tools.description: List the scheduled shifts and leave records of one user between two date-times, with start, end, location and break minutes. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/schedule/users/{userId}.

record_type.description: Only shifts or only leave records (default: both).

tools.name: rotageek_list_location_schedule
tools.title: List a location's schedule
tools.description: List the scheduled shifts and leave records of one location between two date-times, for every user there. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/schedule/locations/{locationId}.

record_type.description: Only shifts or only leave records (default: both).

tools.name: rotageek_list_gaps
tools.title: List open gaps
tools.description: List the open gaps (unfilled shifts) for one or more locations between two date-times. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/gaps/locations.

location_ids.description: Location ids to read the gaps of.

add_tasks.description: Include the tasks of each gap.

tools.name: rotageek_list_leave_requests
tools.title: List leave requests
tools.description: List the leave requests of the organisation, optionally in a leave year or date range. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/leave/requests.

include_overlapping.description: Include requests that only overlap the range.

tools.name: rotageek_list_leave_types
tools.title: List leave types
tools.description: List the leave types (for example holiday or sickness) and their ids. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/leave/types.

tools.name: rotageek_create_leave_request
tools.title: Create a leave request
tools.description: Create a leave request for one user with a leave type id and a start and end date-time. It is saved in Rotageek and can change the rota and holiday balance. Rotageek API: POST /api/v1/leave/requests/users/{userId}.

start_all_day.description: The first day is a whole day.

end_all_day.description: The last day is a whole day.

tools.name: rotageek_get_timesheet
tools.title: Get a week's timesheet
tools.description: Get the timesheet records of one location for the week that starts on weekStartDate: hours scheduled and worked per user. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/timesheets/locations/{locationId}/{weekStartDate}.

week_start_date.description: The first day of the week, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: rotageek_list_positions
tools.title: List positions
tools.description: List the job positions (roles) of the organisation with their ids. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/positions.

tools.name: rotageek_list_skills
tools.title: List skills
tools.description: List the skills of the organisation with their ids. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/skills.

tools.name: rotageek_list_payroll_codes
tools.title: List payroll codes
tools.description: List the payroll codes that shifts and leave map to. Rotageek API: GET /api/v1/payrollcodes.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Rotageek
prompts.description: What you can do with Rotageek here, with example requests to try.
